creator: Claude
name: Family Oak Dining Table
source_format: MagicaVoxel VOX v150 (SIZE, XYZI, RGBA), single model

derived.glb_note: Derived from the .vox by tools/claude/export_glb.py; do not edit by hand. Linear COLOR_0 vertex colours, one material.

resolution_rationale: 0.05 m matches the other household furniture (pilot bed and workbench), so tables, chairs and beds share one voxel rhythm in a room. A 5 cm top, 10 cm legs and apron are real joinery sizes; at 0.10 m the top would be a 10 cm slab and the stretcher would disappear.
godot_mapping: godot = ((vx - px) * s, (vz - pz) * s, -(vy - py) * s)
pivot_note: Bottom centre of the 1.60 x 0.90 m footprint.
front_note: +Y is the long side with the polished places; the table is symmetric enough to be placed either way round.
dimensions_note: Occupied extents of the voxel grid (X width, Y depth, Z height).
gameplay_use: Dining-room furniture; a work and eating surface in the defended house; cover/obstacle; set dressing for kitchen and dining scenes.
palette: Shared Claude palette v2 (tools/claude/voxkit.py); one material family per 8-swatch row in MagicaVoxel's palette grid.
collision_hint: Box 1.60 x 0.90 x 0.75 m at the pivot (or four leg boxes + top slab).
story: An everyday family table, well used and looked after: forearm-polished places along the front, a faint mug ring nobody sanded out and a stretcher polished by restless feet. Left clean when the family went; plates and candles are separate models.
notes: Table height 0.75 m; knee clearance under the apron 0.60 m.
Seats six: two per long side and one at each end.

verification.magicavoxel_gui_open: unverified (MagicaVoxel not available in the build environment)
verification.godot_import: unverified (Godot not available in the build environment)
